senses.gloss: cylinder around which a scroll is rolled, handle.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 3:4">Yad. III, 4</cite> <he>אינו … עד שיעשה לו ע׳</he> does not make the hands unclean, until he fastens a handle to it.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 13b:12">B. Bath. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי לגול ע׳</he> blank margin wide enough to roll around the cylinder.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 14a:4">Ib. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>ספר תורה … ועושה לו ע׳ אילך ואילך</he> a scroll of the Law is rolled (on both sides) towards the middle of it, therefore it must have a handle on each side; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:12">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עַמּוּדִים</he>, <he>עַמּוּדִין</he>. Ib.ᶜ top; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 22a:5">Snh. 22ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="F00004"><he>וא״ו</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: the fecal mass in the rectum; also the jet of urine when being discharged.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 62b:5">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 25a:16">25ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ החוזד וכ׳</he> a suppressed discharge produces dropsy.
